name: Evenings
author: gcrabtree
about: Four slow journeys and a set that plays them in turn. Built-in worlds only, so it adds nothing but the journeys.

name: Hybrids
author: gcrabtree
about: Three worlds that mix two kinds of fold: tetrahedra strung with beads, a cage of bubbles, a sponge folded back on itself. With a journey through all three.

name: Starter pack
author: gcrabtree
about: One of everything a pack can hold: two worlds, palettes, motions, filters, overlays and a journey that uses them.
